name: stocktracking
description: Stock research dashboard with a small market-data proxy

scripts.build:android: mkdir -p dist app && cp index.html app.js analysis.js market-data.js notification-service.js storage-service.js tracking-service.js styles.css icon.svg manifest.webmanifest sw.js dist/ && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk app/Signal-Desk.apk
